description: This file is a shell script that manages changelog entries for a software project. It includes a Node.js script embedded within to process the CHANGELOG.md file, adding or validating PR references and sections. It handles updating changelog sections based on PR numbers, ensuring proper placement of entries, and validating changelog merge hygiene.

methods.name: normalize_pr_changelog_entries
methods.description: Reads the PR number, updates the CHANGELOG.md to include the PR entry in the correct section, creating sections if needed.

methods.name: validate_changelog_entry_for_pr
methods.description: Validates that the changelog entry corresponding to a PR is correctly placed, includes the PR reference, and is properly formatted. Also checks for contributor thanks if specified.

methods.name: validate_changelog_merge_hygiene
methods.description: Ensures that after merge conflicts, PR references are not lost from the changelog.
